title: An Incredible Extension
description: This extension adds Gamma Jack from the Incredibles and other powers into your world! Use Xp to level up your abilities and hone your powers to become...Incredible, there are 15 supers so far, each with unique powers with different strengths.
body:
Hello! this is my first mod for palladium lol, It adds Gamma Jack from the Incredibles into your world for 1.20.1! I plan to continue to add more powers and abilities and an actual obtainment method as time goes on!

note:You must find a meteor in your world and mine the block for the power, make sure it's a diamond pickaxe or higher, or else you will not get the power,this mod was made for/with palladium and such may break if you do not have it installed, upon gaining a power use xp to unlock the rest of your powers, there is no power removal system currently, but mining the meteor core will replace your power! 

Downloading this mod is a great addition for any palladium servers/modpacks you have with your friends!
 

REQUIRES KUBEJS, PEHKUI,  PALLADIUM AND TIME STOP CLOCK(TIme stop clock must be version 4.4.0, or else it will not function correctly.)
